description:
• About our brand and products:

SIGAL is a Miami-based Resortwear Brand rooted in original, hand-painted textile design. Each piece begins as artwork—translated into elevated swimwear, ready-to-wear, and statement sets designed for travel, sun, and a life lived in color. Our collections are inspired by destinations and stories, blending art, culture, and effortless silhouettes.


• What makes us different:

Every print is created in-house by founder and textile artist Sigal, making each piece feel like wearable art rather than mass-produced fashion. We combine a strong artistic point of view with commercial silhouettes that actually sell. The brand sits at the intersection of resortwear, art, and culture—bringing a distinctive, recognizable identity in a sea of sameness.


• How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates earn commission on every sale generated through their unique links or codes. We also prioritize long-term partnerships with top performers, offering opportunities for increased commission tiers, gifting, and exclusive collaborations.


• How to promote us:

SIGAL performs best through visual storytelling. Think:

– Outfit transformations (day to night, beach to dinner)

– “From painting to final look” moments

– Styling videos showing versatility of one piece

– Travel and vacation content

– Close-ups of prints, textures, and movement


Content that feels aspirational, artistic, and sun-soaked resonates most with our audience.


• Other information:

SIGAL is proudly Latina and women-owned, with a strong commitment to ethical production and sustainable materials. The brand is carried by major retailers including Anthropologie and Hemline, and has been featured in Vogue, Elle, Refinery29, and more. We are building a global lifestyle brand centered around art, travel, and self-expression.
payout_period: Commissions are paid out on the 1st of every month for the previous month's sales. We hold a short 15-day window to account for any returns or exchanges. Ex: Sales from January close on January 31st, clear on February 15th, and are paid on March 1st.
